title: Character sheet
description: A sheet for any game: name, concept, six stats you can rename, resources with − and +, abilities, inventory and notes. Each player fills in their own copy.

title: Notes
description: Rich-text notes with headings, lists and quotes. Shared by everyone who can see it, or keep one on the referee's side.

title: Tracker
description: Counters with − and + (health, ammo, coins…) and conditions you tap on or off. Rename everything to fit your game.

title: Turn order
description: Who acts when: names and order, sorted with one tap, a marker on whoever's turn it is, and the round. Everyone sees the marker move.

title: Clocks
description: Progress clocks of 4 to 12 segments, for threats, projects and countdowns, and a timer for scenes against the clock.

title: Party loot
description: The party's money and shared items: who carries what, and what's owed or to sell.

title: Handout
description: A letter or note on paper, to write while it's hidden and reveal when the moment comes. Lock it once it's done.
